rule.en: Never answer a direction question from intuition. Write the chain explicitly (P↑ → … → ?). For identities, substitute signs and solve algebraically. Translate every exchange-rate statement into 'stronger or weaker currency?' before anything else. Trade surplus (X − M > 0) = net capital OUTflow. The saving–investment identity X − M = (S − I) + (T − G) is a recurring sign miss (M3, M6, M7×2): write it, sign each term, then read which way the stem wants it to move.
rule.kr: 방향 문제는 직관으로 답하지 않는다. 연쇄를 끝까지 적고(P↑ → … → ?), 항등식은 부호를 대입해 대수로 푼다. 환율은 무조건 '자국통화 강세/약세'로 먼저 번역. 무역흑자(X − M > 0) = 순자본 유출. 저축–투자 항등식 X − M = (S − I) + (T − G)는 반복 오답(M3, M6, M7×2): 항등식을 쓰고 항마다 부호를 매긴 뒤 지문이 원하는 방향을 읽는다.

evidence: M1 Q3 (elasticity determinants)
M2 Q6 (entry → supply right)
M3 official Q14 (saving ↑ → net exports ↑)
M3 official Q16 (lower P → real FX depreciates)
M3 official Q20 (weak currency raises AD)
M2 official Q6 now correct on retry (supply shifts right)
M5 Ex4 Q3 (money supply ↑ → rates ↓; first direction miss since M3)
M6 official Q6 (H–O: abundant factor gains, scarce loses — picked the flip)
M7 Ex2 Q3 + Q6 (X − M = (S − I) + (T − G): picked T ↑ and I ↓ to shrink a surplus — both grow it; fourth module with a sign miss on this identity)

name.en: Which curve / which relationship? (SRAS vs LRAS, AD vs AS, cost condition vs demand curve)
name.kr: 어느 곡선·어느 관계식? (SRAS vs LRAS, AD vs AS, 비용조건 vs 수요곡선)

rule.en: Cost/price factors (wages, input prices, taxes, subsidies, expectations, FX) move SRAS only; resource/technology factors (labor, capital, productivity) move BOTH. To diagnose a shock from data: output and prices same direction → demand; opposite → supply. Stagflation is never an AD story. Long-run entry/exit thresholds are COST conditions (P = min AC = MC), never a reading off the market demand curve.
rule.kr: 비용·가격 요인(임금·투입가격·세금·보조금·기대·환율)은 SRAS만, 자원·기술 요인(노동·자본·생산성)은 둘 다. 데이터로 충격 진단: 산출과 물가가 같은 방향 → 수요, 반대 → 공급. 스태그플레이션은 절대 AD 이야기가 아님. 장기 진입·퇴출 기준은 비용 조건(P = 최소 AC = MC)이지 시장 수요곡선 값이 아님.

evidence: M3 official Q19 (indexed wages → steeper SRAS)
M3 official Q21 (LRAS left = productivity, not wages)
M3 official Q24 (stagflation ≠ AD shift)
M3 official Q25 (supply shock: long-run price level unchanged unless money expands)
M2 official Q5 (entry threshold = min AC = MC → 66; plugged Q into the demand curve → 81)

name.en: Answering the wrong quantity / grabbing a given number
name.kr: 묻는 양과 다른 숫자 · 주어진 숫자 집기

rule.en: Before choosing, re-read the stem's last line: which stage, which unit, which period, average or marginal, price or quantity? Value added at a step = receipts − ALL purchased inputs; the final price is the whole chain's contribution, not the last step's. If a stem hands you two cost figures and an elasticity, the answer is almost never one of the given figures — apply the rule. Multi-variable demand function: ALWAYS compute Q with every variable plugged in before any elasticity; then use the coefficient of the variable the question names.
rule.kr: 답 고르기 전에 문제의 마지막 줄을 다시 읽는다: 어느 단계·단위·기간, 평균인지 한계인지, 가격인지 수량인지. 단계별 부가가치 = 매출 − 구입 투입 전부; 최종가격은 체인 전체 기여분이지 마지막 단계가 아님. 비용 숫자 두 개와 탄력성이 주어지면 답은 거의 주어진 숫자가 아님 — 규칙을 적용할 것. 다변수 수요함수: 탄력성 전에 모든 변수를 넣어 Q부터 계산, 그 다음 문제가 지목한 변수의 계수 × (그 변수/Q).

evidence: M3 Exhibit 3 (parallel inputs)
M3 official Q5 (value added of final step = 3,000, not 5,000)
M2 official Q4 (picked AC $70; the pricing rule P[1 − 1/ε] = MC gives $120)

rule.en: Every elasticity from a linear demand function is ONE template: E(x) = (coefficient on x) × (x / Q). Variable on top, Q on the bottom, coefficient in front; the sign comes from the coefficient. Step 1 compute Q with all variables; step 2 assemble. Sanity check: if x/Q > 1 the elasticity must be larger than the coefficient, if x/Q < 1 smaller. Distractors: the bare coefficient, the bare ratio, the inverted ratio.
rule.kr: 선형 수요함수의 모든 탄력성은 한 템플릿: E(x) = (x의 계수) × (x / Q). 변수는 위, Q는 아래, 계수는 앞; 부호는 계수가 결정. ①모든 변수 넣어 Q 계산 ②조립. 검산: x/Q > 1이면 탄력성은 계수보다 커야, < 1이면 작아야 함. 함정: 계수만, 비율만, 뒤집힌 비율.

evidence: M1 official Q8 (dropped the coefficient → 0.6)
M1 official Q9 (inverted ratio → 0.5)
M1 official Q10 (inverted ratio)
M1 official Q5 (guessed the cross-price elasticity)

rule.en: 'Annual' over a multi-year span means geometric: (end/start)^(1/n) − 1, never (total %)/n. Same rule as annualized returns in Quant Methods. Nominal = real × inflation is multiplicative, not additive.
rule.kr: 다년간의 '연간' 성장률은 기하평균: (끝/시작)^(1/n) − 1. 총변화율 ÷ n은 오답. QM 연율화 수익률과 같은 규칙. 명목 = 실질 × 물가도 곱셈이지 덧셈이 아님.

evidence: M3 official Q9 (deflator 190 → 212.8 over 2 years = 5.8%/yr, not 6%)
QM sign/annualization error

name.kr: 정의의 한 단어 함정 · 범위 공백

rule.en: For 'best describes' stems, find the single wrong word in each distractor (maximum vs. natural, verifiable, resalable). Natural output is NOT the maximum — it has a modest, stable pool of unemployed. If a topic feels unfamiliar (personal income chain), flag it as a note gap rather than guessing. Part 3 growth terms: labor productivity (output/hour, measurable) vs TFP (residual, inferred) vs potential GDP (estimated).
rule.kr: 'best describes' 문제는 각 오답 선지에서 틀린 단어 하나를 찾는다(maximum vs natural, verifiable, resalable). 자연산출은 '최대'가 아니라 소규모 안정적 실업 풀이 있는 수준. 낯선 주제(개인소득 체인)는 찍지 말고 노트 공백으로 표시. Part 3 성장 용어: 노동생산성(시간당 산출, 측정 가능) vs TFP(잔차, 추정) vs 잠재 GDP(추정치).

evidence: M3 official Q12 (personal income chain — note gap, now §1b)
M3 official Q17 (natural output ≠ maximum)
M3 official Q27 (labor productivity is the directly measurable one)
M3 official Q29 (TFP = output for given inputs)
M2 official Q7 (regulated price = LRAC — repeat miss)
M4 official Q16 + Q19 (headline vs core swapped twice in one set; third time incl. Ex5 Q7)

name.en: Truncated rule — had the rule, dropped a piece
name.kr: 규칙 일부 누락 — 규칙은 알았는데 한 조각을 빠뜨림

rule.en: The rule is a complete object — a full ranking, a full mapping, a trigger word, both halves of a two-object stem. Before reading options: (1) translate the stem into curriculum terms (fixed basket = Laspeyres; equipment sold to firms = I; rising costs = cost-push); (2) write the rule's right-hand side in full; (3) if the stem names two things, the option must cover two. Misses cluster on questions that FEEL easy — that's exactly when this step gets skipped.
rule.kr: 규칙은 하나의 완전한 덩어리다 — 전체 순위, 전체 매핑, 트리거 단어, 두 대상을 묻는 지문의 양쪽. 선지를 읽기 전에 (1) 지문을 교재 용어로 번역(fixed basket = 라스파이레스; 기업용 설비 = I; 비용 상승 = cost-push); (2) 규칙의 우변을 끝까지 쓴다; (3) 지문이 두 가지를 말하면 선지도 두 가지를 덮어야 한다. 오답은 '쉬워 보이는' 문제에 몰린다 — 그때 이 단계를 건너뛴다.

evidence: M4 Ex3 Q3 (ranked durables most cyclical; business I sits above)
M4 Ex1 Q2 (permanent income → services, not saving rate)
M4 Ex5 Q4 ('fixed basket' didn't trigger Laspeyres → overstates)
M4 Ex5 Q6 (stem asked sales AND costs; picked WPI only)
M4 Ex8 Q1 ('rising costs' → pulled demand-pull indicators)
M4 official Q11 (central bank lets economy self-correct → stagflation; picked the overheating row)
M4 official Q15 (Laspeyres overstates → highest inflation; picked Paasche)
M4 official Q18 (quality bias is upward even at constant price; picked 'unaffected')
M4 official Q20 (two-bullet stem; the second bullet was the literal cost-push definition)
M5 Ex3 Q1 (transactions motive — label swap among the three money-demand definitions)
M5 official Q2 (money-demand motives — second label swap; precautionary ∝ GDP)
M6 official Q8 (patent FEES + legal services → current account services; picked financial)
M7 Ex1 Q3 (hedged zero held to maturity = risk free; dropped the clause that switches rate risk off)

name.en: Off-model option — a phrase the curriculum never uses
name.kr: 교재에 없는 선지 — 교재가 쓰지 않는 표현을 고름

rule.en: If the chosen option isn't a phrase the curriculum uses for that concept, stop. Adjacent concepts (interest rates ~ money; bias ~ noise; policy ~ growth) are the standard lure. Hedge options ('either / both / any') are distractors unless the curriculum literally says both apply. A reason that would make behavior MORE stable can't explain cyclicality.
rule.kr: 고른 선지가 그 개념에 대해 교재가 쓰는 표현이 아니면 멈춘다. 인접 개념(금리 ~ 통화; 편의 ~ 노이즈; 정책 ~ 성장)이 표준 유인. '둘 다/either/any' 식 헤지 선지는 교재가 명시적으로 둘 다라고 하지 않는 한 오답. 행동을 '더 안정적'으로 만드는 이유는 경기순응성을 설명할 수 없다.

evidence: M4 Ex1 Q1 (durables cyclical because 'needed more' — reverse logic)
M4 Ex3 Q1 (imports respond to 'industrial policy' — not in the model)
M4 Ex5 Q7 (headline 'has upward bias' — bias is methodology; headline is noisier)
M4 Ex8 Q6 (Monetarists → 'interest rates'; it's money growth)
M4 Ex8 Q3 (cost-push when unemployment 'either high or low' — hedge)
M4 official Q16 ('index of food and energy prices' for policy — not a concept; core inflation)
M5 Ex4 Q3 (money supply ↑ → 'reduces equilibrium money held' — sophisticated-sounding lure; answer is rates ↓)
M5 official Q5 ('efficient markets' as the assumption behind monetary policy — not in the reading; it's short-run non-neutrality)
M5 official Q7 (stable real rate → picked money neutrality; it's the Fisher effect)
M7 Ex2 Q2 (what makes Marshall–Lerner more likely to hold = higher elasticities; picked lower ε_M + higher ω_M)

name.en: Stem negation — NOT / EXCEPT / least likely
name.kr: 부정 지문 — NOT / EXCEPT / least likely

rule.en: On a NOT stem, mark every option T/F against the curriculum, then pick the F. In a NOT question a TRUE statement is the distractor; 'sounds right' is the trap. Second miss on official Q14 — the routine is not yet automatic: physically write T/F next to each option before choosing.
rule.kr: NOT 지문에서는 선지마다 교재 기준 T/F를 표시한 뒤 F를 고른다. NOT 문제에서 '맞는 말'은 오답이다 — 그럴듯하게 들리는 것이 함정. 공식 Q14에서 두 번째 오답 — 아직 자동화되지 않음: 고르기 전에 선지 옆에 T/F를 실제로 적는다.

evidence: M4 Ex7 Q1 (NAIRU 'NOT a problem' — picked a TRUE limitation); Ex8 Q8 retest ✓
M4 official Q14 (PPI least likely — picked TRUE 'leads CPI'; false one is 'labor contracts use PPI')
M6 official Q10 ('least alarming' deficit condition → investment; picked consumption) — third negation miss

name.en: FX hedging translation — long what → sell it forward
name.kr: 환헤지 번역 — 무엇을 롱인가 → 그것을 선도 매도

rule.en: Four steps before reading options: (1) which currency am I LONG in the cash market? (2) the risk is that currency's FUTURE SPOT rate — today's forward is a known price, a later forward is irrelevant; (3) the hedge is to SELL that currency forward (= buy domestic forward); (4) the setup is SELL domestic spot → invest foreign → BUY domestic forward. A hedged, risk-free, zero-coupon bond held to maturity has no default, reinvestment, rate, or FX risk. Naming the right instrument with the wrong currency is the standard miss.
rule.kr: 선지 읽기 전 4단계: (1) 현물에서 어떤 통화를 롱인가? (2) 위험 = 그 통화의 '미래 현물' 환율 — 오늘의 선도는 알려진 가격, 나중의 선도는 무관; (3) 헤지 = 그 통화를 선도 '매도'(= 자국통화 선도 매수); (4) 설정 = 자국통화 현물 매도 → 해외 투자 → 자국통화 선도 매수. 헤지된 무위험·무이표·만기보유 채권은 부도·재투자·금리·환 위험 모두 없음. 상품은 맞고 통화가 틀리는 것이 전형적 오답.

evidence: M7 Ex1 Q1 (risk = future spot; picked 'forward rate one year from now')
M7 Ex1 Q2 (sell HKD forward; picked sell AUD forward — right instrument, wrong currency)
M7 Ex1 Q3 (hedged held-to-maturity zero = risk free; picked interest-rate risk)
M7 Ex1 Q4 (setup: SELL AUD spot first; picked buy AUD spot)

official_misses.note: Chose the final sale price (5,000) instead of value added at the last step (3,000).
Divided the 2-year change by 2 (6%) instead of annualizing geometrically (5.8%).
Personal income chain was not in the notes — knowledge gap, now covered in §1b.
Flipped the identity: higher saving with I, Y fixed must raise net exports (capital outflow), not lower them.
Lower price level → real exchange rate DEPRECIATES → net exports rise. Chose appreciation.
Natural level of output is not the maximum obtainable; it has a modest stable pool of unemployed.
Indexed wages remove the margin incentive → SRAS steeper, not unchanged.
A weak currency RAISES AD (exports cheaper); it cannot be a cause of an AD decrease.
LRAS shifts only with resource/technology factors (productivity); nominal wages move SRAS only.
Stagflation comes from an SRAS shift, so it is the one NOT caused by AD.
Supply shock raises prices only in the short run; with no money expansion the long-run price level is unchanged. Chose 'keeps rising proportionally'.
Labor productivity (output/hour) is directly measurable; TFP is a residual.
TFP↑ = more output for given inputs (the A in Y = A·F(K,L)), not the sustainable growth rate itself.
Picked the given average cost ($70). Apply MR = MC with MR = P[1 − 1/ε]: P = 40/(1/3) = $120.
Entry threshold is P = min AC = MC = 66 (Q = 8). 81 came from plugging Q = 8 into the market demand curve — wrong relationship.
Regulated price = long-run average cost (normal return). Repeat of the earlier Q7 miss.
Guessed (counted as a miss). Same template: Q = 24.8375, then −0.16 × 3.75/Q = −0.0242.
Picked 0.6 = 38/62.4 — the ratio without the coefficient. E = −3.1 × 38/62.4 = −1.9.
Formula assembled wrong. E = 0.9 × 18/62.4 = 0.3 (weak substitutes).
Ex1 Q1 — picked 'needed more'. Long useful life → deferrable → cyclical. (off-model)
Ex1 Q2 — picked saving rate. Permanent income → services. (truncated rule)
Ex3 Q1 — picked 'industrial policy'. Imports ← domestic GDP growth. (off-model)
Ex3 Q3 — picked consumer durables. Equipment sold to firms = I = most cyclical. (truncated rule)
Ex5 Q4 — picked 'tracks closely'. Fixed basket → Laspeyres → overstates. (truncated rule)
Ex5 Q6 — picked WPI only. Sales → CPI sub-index, costs → WPI sub-index: both. (truncated rule)
Ex5 Q7 — picked 'upward bias'. Headline is noisier; bias = construction methodology. (off-model)
Ex7 Q1 — NOT question, picked a TRUE limitation. T/F every option, pick the F. Retest Ex8 Q8 ✓. (negation)
Ex8 Q1 — 'rising costs' but pulled money vs GDP. Cost-push → UR vs NAIRU, wages vs productivity. (truncated rule)
Ex8 Q3 — picked hedge 'either high or low'. Cost-push when unemployment is LOW. (off-model)
Ex8 Q6 — picked 'interest rates'. Monetarists → money growth. (off-model)

Official Q11 — stem said 'allow to self-correct', picked the OVERHEATING row (high inflation + fast growth + low UR). Self-correct = STAGFLATION (high inflation + slow growth + high UR). Two-row mapping, wrong row. (truncated rule)
Official Q14 — least-likely stem, picked a TRUE statement (PPI leads CPI). False one: labor contracts ← CPI, not PPI. Second negation miss. (negation + indexation mapping)
Official Q15 — picked current basket (Paasche) as highest. Laspeyres overstates → highest (10% > Fisher 8.99% > Paasche 8%). (truncated rule)
Official Q16 — picked 'index of food and energy prices' for policy. Core inflation. Off-model option built from the definition's words. (off-model)
Official Q18 — quality ↑, price constant → picked 'unaffected'. Quality bias = upward even with no price change. Repeat of Ex5 Q4 (S-Q-N). (truncated rule)
Official Q19 — ex food & energy → picked headline. Core. Second headline/core miss in the same set (with Q16); third overall with Ex5 Q7. (definition — repeat)
Official Q20 — 'wages compel retailers to raise prices' → picked demand-pull. Cost-push. Read the first bullet only. (truncated rule — half the stem)
M5 Ex3 Q1 — transactions motive: picked the speculative definition. Keywords: transactions = purchases; precautionary = unforeseen; speculative = other assets. (truncated rule / label swap)
M5 Ex4 Q3 — money supply ↑: picked 'reduces equilibrium money held'. M ↑ → i ↓ → P ↑; equilibrium money held RISES, movement along MD. First direction miss since M3. (off-model + polarity)
M5 official Q2 — picked 'transactions demand inversely related to bond returns' (that's speculative). Precautionary ∝ GDP. Second motive label swap (after Ex3 Q1). (truncated rule — repeat)
M5 official Q5 — fundamental assumption of monetary policy = money NOT neutral in the short run; picked 'efficient markets' (not in the reading). Note gap, now added. (off-model)
M5 official Q7 — 'real rate stable' is the FISHER effect; picked money neutrality (adjacent concept). (off-model)
M6 official Q6 — picked 'scarce factor gains'. H–O: export good uses the ABUNDANT factor → abundant factor gains, scarce loses. (polarity)
M6 official Q8 — patent fees + legal services → picked financial account. Services → CURRENT account; only the patent SALE is capital. The note's own patent trap. (truncated rule)
M6 official Q10 — 'least alarming' deficit condition: picked high consumption. Investment-financed deficit improves repayment capacity → least alarming. Third negation miss. (negation + quality rule)
M7 Ex1 Q1 — risk = future SPOT; picked 'forward rate one year from now'. (off-model / hedge routine)
M7 Ex1 Q2 — hedge = sell HKD forward (the currency she's long); picked sell AUD forward. (hedge direction)
M7 Ex1 Q3 — hedged held-to-maturity zero = risk free; picked interest-rate risk. Dropped 'zero coupon, held to maturity'. (truncated rule)
M7 Ex1 Q4 — setup = SELL AUD spot → buy HKD bond → BUY AUD forward; picked buy AUD spot. First leg inverted. (hedge direction)
M7 Ex2 Q2 — 'more likely to reduce the surplus' = higher elasticities; picked ε_M ↓ + ω_M ↑ (the opposite). (off-model)
M7 Ex2 Q3 — X − M = (S − I) + (T − G): reduce a surplus → I ↑; picked tax receipts ↑ (grows it). (polarity — identity signs, 3rd module)
M7 Ex2 Q6 — surplus to zero → S ↓; picked I ↓ (grows it). Same identity, two questions apart. (polarity — identity signs)
